title: Khaitan & Co Disputes Partner Aakash Bajaj to launch independent practice
description: Aakash Bajaj is set to leave Khaitan & Co to establish his independent counsel practice in Kolkata and Delhi.Commenting on Bajaj's exit, Khaitan Executive Director Amar Sinhji said,"Aakash is moving on to build an independent practice. We thank him for his contribution to the growth of our Firm and wish him all the very best in his future endeavours."Bajaj commenced his career with Khaitan & Co and was made a Partner in the Delhi office in 2022.
